audit.whatIsWrong: Every full-layer phases[].side read 'Lissandra' while content win[] and the packet levelChart read Skill, Skill, Skill, Skill, Ekko, Ekko, Ekko — a disagreement on all seven rows.
audit.why: The content chart matches the kit and the 51.46% win rate over 1708 games: Lissandra's threat is a 450-range root and a defensive ultimate, neither of which wins her the level 6 and item rows the full layer handed her.
audit.corrected: All seven sides moved onto the content/packet chart with the ratings brought down with them; phases[0], [2] and [4] whys rewritten in the same group where the old text no longer matched or was misgendered. win[] already holds the target values so no paired value change exists.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1] treated level 6 as a straightforward Ekko spike without naming what Frozen Tomb actually does.
audit.why: Frozen Tomb is 120/100/80 and can be self-cast for untargetability, invulnerability and a heal — the single reason a committed Ekko combo can be worth nothing at 6.
audit.corrected: spikes[1] rewritten to bait-then-dive sequencing around a 120-second ultimate; the same interaction added to phases[4].why, breakdown.carry and wants.you[1].
sources: brief enemyKit R text and flags

audit.whatIsWrong: Three fields attributed the root to the wrong ability: whys[2] and spikes[0] to Glacial Path, spikes[2] to Ice Shard. Two more (wants.you[1], wants.foe[0]) referenced 'Claw Marks stacks', which is not a Lissandra ability at all.
audit.why: Ring of Frost (W, 10/9.5/9/8.5/8, 450 range) is the root. Glacial Path (E, 24/21/18/15/12, 1050) is a claw she can travel to and applies no CC. Ice Shard (Q, 725) slows. Nothing in her kit stacks or empowers an auto-attack.
audit.corrected: Root reassigned to Ring of Frost everywhere; the invented 'Claw Marks' replaced with the real poke pattern (Ice Shard at 725 with a slow) and with the Frozen Tomb self-cast.

audit.why: Glacial Path is her longest cooldown at 24s rank 1 and she is immobile for all of it — that is the commit window, and it never reached the page as a number.
audit.corrected: Glacial Path 24s, Ring of Frost 10s at 450, Frozen Tomb 120s and Chronobreak 110s all written in, with the same sequencing repeated in dosFull[0].d and breakdown.mid.

audit.whatIsWrong: 15 misgendering fields (Lissandra called he/his/him), dosFull[1].d was tradeGood verbatim and dontsFull[2].d was tradeBad verbatim.
audit.why: Lissandra is female per champ-gender.js; a bullet body must explain its own title.
audit.corrected: Pronouns fixed and both bled bullets replaced with bodies matching their titles.

audit.why: Both packet suspectNames hits ('Drive Resonance' from Z-Drive Resonance, 'Use Glacial Path') are false positives — the underlying names are correct.
audit.corrected: No name change on that basis; wants.foe[1] was still rewritten because it named the wrong ability as the root.

edits.before: Lissandra's Ice Shard-Claw poke plus a well-timed Glacial Path root gives her real trading power in this window, but her low base damage and Ekko's own Timewinder poke keep the exchange close and skill-dependent rather than one-sided.
edits.after: Lissandra's Ice Shard poke into a Glacial Path step-up gives her real trading power in this window, but the root is Ring of Frost at 450 range, so her low base damage and your 1075 Q keep the exchange close and skill-dependent.

edits.before: Ekko's Chronobreak comes online right as Lissandra's own ultimate is more of a peel/save tool than a lane-kill button, so this is where Ekko's kit starts to pull ahead — you can dive her all-in attempts and reset out if she oversteps.
edits.after: Chronobreak comes online just as Frozen Tomb proves to be a peel and save button — self-cast it makes her untargetable, invulnerable and healed, so bait it out rather than dumping your combo into it, then dive her the moment it is spent.

edits.before: With a first item, Ekko's burst from Z-Drive Resonance plus Parallel Convergence outpaces Lissandra's poke-based damage output, and her Ice Shard root alone isn't enough to stop your all-in once you're in range.

edits.before: - Lissandra Glacial Path (Claw): matchup-defining — Her engage and escape in one button — she is immobile while it is down. Check it before every step-up. - R Chronobreak is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.
edits.after: - Glacial Path: 24s at rank 1, still 12s at rank 5 — she is immobile the whole time it is down. - Ring of Frost roots on 10s at 450 range. - Frozen Tomb is 120s and can be self-cast. - Chronobreak is 110s at rank 1: fights, not waves.

edits.before: First item onward, trade like the rewind exists: dive the chipped, W the peel, R the answer. Your tempo compounds.
edits.after: First item onward, force the fight while Glacial Path is down — 18s at rank 3 is the longest gap anywhere in her kit.
